tools.name: search
tools.description: Find or list one or more current public BrinkerAdvisor CD, money-market, Treasury, or municipal rate records by product, institution, term, or maturity when no exact stable record ID is supplied. Discovery of several matching records returns a list, not a side-by-side comparison. Returns stable IDs,

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve complete yield, term, freshness, canonical link, and original-source provenance for one current public BrinkerAdvisor record when its exact stable record ID is already supplied. Requires one known ID and returns one record. The top-level url is the canonical BrinkerAdvisor link; metadata.so

tools.name: compare_rates
tools.description: Create a bounded side-by-side comparison for an explicit comparison or contrast of current CD, money-market, Treasury, or municipal options with instrument and maturity filters. tools.name: build_ladder
tools.description: Build an educational equal-weight maturity ladder from current eligible public CD, money-market, Treasury, or municipal options for a requested rung count and term range. Every covered rung contains a canonical brinkeradvisor_url and an original source_name and source_url. Returns explicit uncovered

tools.name: mention_rates
tools.description: Search current public rate records for the desktop composer resource picker.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
